 # Audit Event Reference
 
-TODO: Document the workflow audit event fields and handling requirements.
+Every Stage 4 workflow step emits one audit event per attempt. This document
+defines the required fields, an example event, and the rules governing
+ordering, hashing, redaction, and cost aggregation.
+
+## Fields
+
+| Field | Type | Description |
+|---|---|---|
+| `run_id` | string | Identifier for the overall workflow run. |
+| `step_id` | string | Identifier for the step within the run. |
+| `attempt` | integer | 1-based retry counter for the step. |
+| `timestamp` | string (ISO 8601) | Time the event was recorded, UTC. |
+| `agent` | string | Name of the agent that executed the step. |
+| `model` | string | Model identifier used for the step. |
+| `input_tokens` | integer | Tokens consumed by the input. |
+| `output_tokens` | integer | Tokens produced in the output. |
+| `cost_usd` | number | Cost of the attempt in USD. |
+| `input_hash` | string | SHA-256 hex digest of the (redacted) input. |
+| `output_hash` | string | SHA-256 hex digest of the (redacted) output. |
+| `guard_outcome` | string | Result of guard evaluation: `PASS`, `FAIL`, or `BLOCK`. |
+| `transition` | string | Resulting state transition or event name. |
+| `failure_origin` | string \| null | Stage/component that caused a failure, or `null`. |
+| `human_gate` | object \| null | `{ "actor": ..., "action": ... }` for human-gated steps, or `null`. |
+
+## Example event
+
+```json
+{
+  "run_id": "run_2f8a9c",
+  "step_id": "step_build",
+  "attempt": 1,
+  "timestamp": "2026-09-15T14:32:07Z",
+  "agent": "builder",
+  "model": "claude-sonnet-5",
+  "input_tokens": 1820,
+  "output_tokens": 640,
+  "cost_usd": 0.0421,
+  "input_hash": "a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9",
+  "output_hash": "9f8e7d6c5b4a30201f2e3d4c5b6a79880f1e2d3c4b5a69780f1e2d3c4b5a698",
+  "guard_outcome": "PASS",
+  "transition": "step_completed",
+  "failure_origin": null,
+  "human_gate": {
+    "actor": "reviewer@example.com",
+    "action": "approved"
+  }
+}
+```
+
+## Ordering
+
+Events are appended in strictly monotonic order, sorted first by `run_id`,
+then by `step_id`, then by `attempt`, then by `timestamp`. A step retry
+produces a new event with the same `run_id`/`step_id` and an incremented
+`attempt`; it must never overwrite a prior attempt's event.
+
+## Hash purpose
+
+`input_hash` and `output_hash` exist to support integrity verification,
+deduplication, and tamper detection without persisting raw payload content in
+the audit trail. Two events with matching hashes for the same step indicate
+an idempotent retry; a mismatch between a recomputed hash and the logged hash
+indicates the underlying artifact was altered after the fact.
+
+## Secret redaction
+
+No secrets, credentials, or PII may appear in raw audit fields. Inputs and
+outputs must be hashed or redacted before logging: patterns resembling API
+keys, bearer tokens, passwords, and connection strings must be stripped or
+masked prior to computing `input_hash`/`output_hash`, and never written
+verbatim into `agent`, `transition`, or `failure_origin`. Redaction happens
+at capture time, not as a later cleanup pass.
+
+## Cost aggregation
+
+`cost_usd` is tracked per attempt in USD with a minimum of four decimal
+places of precision. Costs roll up by summing all attempts for a `step_id`
+to get step cost, and summing all step costs for a `run_id` to get total
+run cost. Failed attempts still contribute their `cost_usd` to the run total,
+since tokens were consumed regardless of outcome.
